y-m-63-07.topic: Isibalo somugqa othintayo: imigqa ethintayo edwetshwe ephoyintini langaphandle lejika

y-m-63-07.material:
Kunejika u-y=x² nephoyinti u-P(1, −3). (Funda 'y is x squared'.) Uma u-x=1, inani luka-y lejika ngu-1, ngakho iphoyinti u-P akuyona iphoyinti elisejikeni. UNara wakuxazulula kanje.
"Uma u-f(x)=x², bese u-f′(x)=2x no-f′(1)=2. Ngakho umugqa othintayo odlula ephoyintini u-P(1, −3) onokuthambeka u-2 ngu-y−(−3)=2(x−1), okungukuthi, u-y=2x−5."
Umugqa othintayo umugqa odlula ephoyintini elisejikeni (iphoyinti lokuthinta) futhi onenani le-derivative kuleli phoyinti njengokuthambeka kwawo.

y-m-63-01.topic: Imikhawulo yemisebenzi: imikhawulo yesobunxele nesokudla, nomehluko phakathi kwenani lomkhawulo nenani lomsebenzi
y-m-63-01.goal: Isikhathi ngasinye lapho idatha yethebula yembulwa, lungisa isinqumo sakho nezinga lokuzethemba ngomkhawulo, bese uchaza ukuthi inani lomkhawulo ngumbuzo ohlukile kunenani lomsebenzi ku-x=2.
y-m-63-01.material: Umsebenzi f uchazwa njengo-f(x)=(x²−4)/(x−2) lapho x≠2. (Ufunde njenge-'x squared minus 4' ehlukaniswe nge-'x minus 2'.) Inani ku-x=2 alinikezwa ekuqaleni. Amanani e-f(x) atholwa ngekhalkhulethara ngokuthumela u-x eduze no-2 embulwa isinyathelo ngesinyathelo. Lapha 'inani lomkhawulo' yinani u-f(x) alisondela lapho x ihlukile ku-2 futhi isondela ku-2 ngokungenamkhawulo.

y-m-63-01.thinking.2: Hlukanisa ukuthi iyiphi ingxenye yesinqumo ulwazi olusha oluyishintshayo nokuthi iyiphi angayishintshi

Cabanga ukuthi usevele wafunda imikhawulo, ukuqhubeka, nokuhlukanisa imisebenzi ye-polynomial ku-Calculus I.

y-m-63-02.title: Uma umkhawulo wesamba ukhona, imikhawulo yomsebenzi ngamunye nayo ikhona?
y-m-63-02.topic: Izimfanelo zemikhawulo yemisebenzi: umkhawulo wesamba nezibonelo eziphikisayo
y-m-63-02.goal: Phikisa isimangalo esithi 'uma umkhawulo wesamba ukhona, imikhawulo yomsebenzi ngamunye ikhona' ngesibonelo esiphikisayo, bese uhlunga ukuthi umthetho wesamba wemikhawulo ubamba ohlangothini luphi.
y-m-63-02.material: UGyuri uthe, "Uma umkhawulo ka-f(x)+g(x) ukhona lapho x isondela ku-0, khona umkhawulo ka-f(x) nomkhawulo ka-g(x) ngamunye nawo ukhona." Lapha f no-g yimisebenzi echazwe eduze no-x=0 (x≠0). 'Umkhawulo ukhona' kusho ukuthi usondela enombolweni eyodwa yangempela, futhi izimo lapho ikhula ngaphandle komkhawulo noma incipha ngaphandle komkhawulo, noma lapho okwesobunxele nokwesokudla kuhlukile, kubizwa ngokuthi 'umkhawulo awukho'. 1/x ifundwa 'one over x'.
y-m-63-02.thinking.1: Yakha isibonelo esiphikisayo ngebhanqa lemisebenzi ekhansela
y-m-63-02.prereq.1: Umthetho wesamba wemikhawulo (uma ngamunye unomkhawulo, umkhawulo wesamba isamba semikhawulo)
y-m-63-02.prereq.2: Iqiniso lokuthi umkhawulo ka-1/x lapho x isondela ku-0 awukho (ukhula noma uncipha ngaphandle komkhawulo)
y-m-63-02.s.s1.prompt: Iyiphi impendulo yokuqala efaneleke kakhulu lapho ubona isimangalo sikaGyuri okokuqala?

y-m-63-02.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala ngefomula ukuthi uthola isimo muni uma wengeza leyo misebenzi emibili.
y-m-63-02.s.s1.o.a: Iyiqiniso. Umthetho wesamba wemikhawulo usho ncamashi lokho.
y-m-63-02.s.s1.r.a: Lokhu ukucabanga okungahloli ukuthi 'ingcabango' no-'isiphetho' somthetho wesamba kuphindiwe uma kuqhathaniswa nesimangalo.
y-m-63-02.s.s1.o.b: Kubonakala kuyiqiniso. Uma isamba sisondela enombolweni, ingxenye ngayinye kumele ibe seduze nenombolo ethile.
y-m-63-02.s.s1.r.b: Lokhu ukucabanga okucabange ukuthi uma isamba sizinzile, ingxenye ngayinye nayo izinzile. Akuzange kubhekwe ukuthi amanani amakhulu angakhansela omunye komunye yini.
y-m-63-02.s.s1.o.c: Kungase kube ngamanga. Noma ngamunye ukhula futhi uncipha, bangakhansela esambeni.
y-m-63-02.s.s1.r.c: Lokhu ukucabanga okungavumi nje isimangalo kodwa kuzama ukuthola futhi kuhlole ngqo icala lapho ukukhansela kwenzeka esambeni.
y-m-63-02.s.s1.o.d: Asikwazi ukusho. Asikwazi ukufaka u-0, ngakho asikwazi ukunquma umkhawulo.
y-m-63-02.s.s1.r.d: Lokhu ukucabanga okudele ukunquma ngoba u-x=0 awukwazi ukufakwa. Kukhona indlela yokubheka ukuthi amanani asondela kanjani.
y-m-63-02.s.s1.explain: Ukuhlola ukuthi isimangalo siyiqiniso 'njalo', indlela eqonde kakhulu ukufuna isibonelo lapho umkhawulo wesamba ukhona kodwa owemisebenzi ngayinye ungekho.
y-m-63-02.s.s2.prompt: Nge-f(x)=a/x no-g(x)=b/x+c (x≠0, futhi a, b, c ziyizinombolo eziphelele kusuka ku-−9 kuya ku-9), yenza izibonelo ezi-2 ezihlukile lapho isimangalo sikaGyuri singalungile. Umkhawulo ka-f(x)+g(x) kumele ukhona kodwa owa-f kumele ungabi khona.
y-m-63-02.s.s2.hint.0: Hlanganisa f(x)+g(x) ube yingxenyana eyodwa bese ubheka ukuthi ingxenye lapho x isala esihlukanisini kumele yenzeke kanjani ukuze isamba sibe nombolo engaguquki.
y-m-63-02.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha inani elingeyona u-0 lika-a, bese ukhetha b ukuze ingxenye yesamba enge-x esihlukanisini ibhubhe.

y-m-63-02.s.s2.explain: Ku-f(x)+g(x)=(a+b)/x+c, uma a+b=0 isamba siyinombolo engaguquki c. Kodwa uma a≠0, kokubili f no-g kukhula noma kuncipha ngaphandle komkhawulo njengoba x isondela ku-0, ngakho imikhawulo yazo ayikho. Isibonelo, uma f(x)=1/x no-g(x)=−1/x, isamba singu-0 ngakho umkhawulo walo ungu-0, kodwa akukho nomkhawulo ngamunye.
y-m-63-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Esibonelweni osenzile, chaza ngomusho owodwa noma emibili ukuthi f(x) no-g(x) ngayinye yenzani njengoba x isondela ku-0, nokuthi kungani isamba sinomkhawulo.

y-m-63-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubhale ngokwehlukana isizathu sokuthi f no-g ngayinye ayinawo umkhawulo nesizathu sokuthi isamba sinawo?
y-m-63-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ucaphune izinombolo ezithile (a, b, c) owazenzile njengesisekelo?
y-m-63-02.s.s2.because.model.0: f(x)=1/x no-g(x)=−1/x zikhula noma ziyancipha ngaphandle komkhawulo njengoba x isondela ku-0, ngakho ngayinye ayinawo umkhawulo. Kodwa uma uzengeza uthola u-0, ngakho umkhawulo wesamba ungu-0.
y-m-63-02.s.s2.because.model.1: a/x no-−a/x+c ngayinye iyaphambuka ngoba isihlukanisi sisondela ku-0, kodwa uma wengeza imisebenzi emibili, izingxenye ezine-x ziyakhansela futhi kusala inombolo engaguquki c kuphela, ngakho isamba sisondela ku-c.

y-m-63-02.s.s3.hint.0: Faka u-f no-g owenze esinyathelweni sangaphambilini esitatimendeni ngasinye bese uhlola ukuthi isitatimende siyaphuka yini.

y-m-63-02.s.s3.o.a: Uma umkhawulo ka-f+g ukhona, imikhawulo ka-f no-g ngamunye nayo ikhona.
y-m-63-02.s.s3.r.a: Lesi yisinqumo esathatha njengeqiniso isiqondiso esibuyela emuva kusukela emkhawulweni wesamba siye emkhawulweni wengxenye ngayinye. Khumbula isibonelo esiphikisayo sesinyathelo sangaphambilini.
y-m-63-02.s.s3.o.b: Uma imikhawulo yazo zombili f no-g ikhona, umkhawulo ka-f+g nawo ukhona.
y-m-63-02.s.s3.r.b: Lesi yisinqumo esafunda kahle isiqondiso somthetho wesamba wemikhawulo (uma ngamunye ukhona, isamba sikhona).
y-m-63-02.s.s3.o.c: Uma nomkhawulo ka-f noma ka-g ungekho, umkhawulo ka-f+g nawo awukho.
